LESSON: WRITING 11.5.1 MECHANICS OF WRITING: PREFIXES AND SUFFIXES

Grade: Grade 8
Subject: ENGLISH
Strand: Strand 11
Topic 11.5: Writing 11.5.1 Mechanics of Writing: Prefixes and Suffixes
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 2

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Writing 11.5.1 Mechanics of Writing: Prefixes and Suffixes, part of Strand 11 in Grade 8 ENGLISH.

Key inquiry question: How can you tell the meaning of a word using a prefix? 2. Which words with suffixes and prefixes are confusing?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Writing 11.5.1 Mechanics of Writing: Prefixes and Suffixes together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
• Collaboration: It is enhanced as the learner generates lists of words with prefixes and suffixes in groups or pairs.

• Creativity and imagination: It is enhanced as the learner performs different tasks on prefixes and suffixes.

Values:
Unity: It is promoted as the learner searches for more examples of words using prefixes and suffixes in groups.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
(PCIs):

Creative thinking skills: They are developed as the learner formulates sentences using different forms of words.

Link to other Learning Areas:

Word formation is related to learning of vocabulary which is subject specific for example in Agriculture and Nutition..
